title: Four Hands at One Piano  (Cuatro manos en un piano)

segments.t: A la una y media, dentro de la soleada habitación nueve, Evelyn se desliza hacia la derecha en la larga banqueta de nogal del piano para que Caleb ocupe las teclas graves de la izquierda en su dúo de bienvenida a cuatro manos. Escucha primero toda la escena.
Three sharp, Evelyn — my hands have not played four-hand piano since I was twelve!
Your left hand remembers every chord, Caleb; just stop counting bars like brick walls!
Sorry! Habit of an architect: one-two-three, four-point-zero meters to the window!
Think of our courtyard tree swaying gently in Friday wind instead of a ruler.
All right, deep breath... bass chord C, warm G, up to A minor...
Lovely! Hear how rich the lower walnut strings sound beneath my melody on top?
Watch out — here comes that fast turn at bar sixteen where I always rush!
Listen to my right hand breathe first, then step in like an old friend answering.
One, two, step in... hey, middle D sang right between our hands without a hitch!
Bravo, Caleb! Your old cartography professor is going to beam from ear to ear!
Wait — look out the arched window: Tessa and Owen are carrying four hot tins outside!
One more run from the top, partner, while the summer berry cakes cool in the shade!
Analicemos ahora, compás a compás, este ensayo a cuatro manos.
Three sharp, Evelyn — my hands have not played four-hand piano since I was twelve!
'A las tres en punto, Evelyn... ¡mis manos no han tocado piano a cuatro manos desde que tenía doce años!'
Your left hand remembers every chord, Caleb; just stop counting bars like brick walls!
'Tu mano izquierda recuerda cada acorde, Caleb; ¡solo deja de contar los compases como si fueran muros de ladrillo!'
Sorry! Habit of an architect: one-two-three, four-point-zero meters to the window!
'¡Perdón! Manías de arquitecto: un, dos, tres, ¡cuatro coma cero metros hasta la ventana!'
Think of our courtyard tree swaying gently in Friday wind instead of a ruler.
'Piensa en el árbol de nuestro patio meciéndose suavemente con el viento del viernes, en lugar de en una regla.'
All right, deep breath... bass chord C, warm G, up to A minor...
'Muy bien, respiro hondo... acorde grave en do, sol cálido, y subimos a la menor...'
Lovely! Hear how rich the lower walnut strings sound beneath my melody on top?
'¡Precioso! ¿Oyes lo ricas que suenan las cuerdas graves de nogal bajo mi melodía de arriba?'
Watch out — here comes that fast turn at bar sixteen where I always rush!
'¡Cuidado! Aquí viene ese giro rápido del compás dieciséis donde siempre me acelero.'
Listen to my right hand breathe first, then step in like an old friend answering.
'Escucha primero cómo respira mi mano derecha y luego entra como un viejo amigo que responde.'
One, two, step in... hey, middle D sang right between our hands without a hitch!
'Un, dos, entro... ¡eh, el re central sonó justo entre nuestras manos sin ningún tropiezo!'
Bravo, Caleb! Your old cartography professor is going to beam from ear to ear!
'¡Bravo, Caleb! ¡Tu antiguo profesor de cartografía va a sonreír de oreja a oreja!'
Wait — look out the arched window: Tessa and Owen are carrying four hot tins outside!
'Espera, mira por la ventana en arco: ¡Tessa y Owen están sacando cuatro moldes calientes afuera!'
One more run from the top, partner, while the summer berry cakes cool in the shade!
'¡Una pasada más desde el principio, compañero, mientras los pasteles de bayas de verano se enfrían a la sombra!'
Volvamos a escuchar el ensayo completo, de principio a fin.
Three sharp, Evelyn — my hands have not played four-hand piano since I was twelve!
Your left hand remembers every chord, Caleb; just stop counting bars like brick walls!
Sorry! Habit of an architect: one-two-three, four-point-zero meters to the window!
Think of our courtyard tree swaying gently in Friday wind instead of a ruler.
All right, deep breath... bass chord C, warm G, up to A minor...
Lovely! Hear how rich the lower walnut strings sound beneath my melody on top?
Watch out — here comes that fast turn at bar sixteen where I always rush!
Listen to my right hand breathe first, then step in like an old friend answering.
One, two, step in... hey, middle D sang right between our hands without a hitch!
Bravo, Caleb! Your old cartography professor is going to beam from ear to ear!
Wait — look out the arched window: Tessa and Owen are carrying four hot tins outside!
One more run from the top, partner, while the summer berry cakes cool in the shade!
Los acordes graves y los agudos brillantes se funden con suavidad a través de los postigos verdes abiertos mientras cuatro pasteles dorados salen al patio. Nos vemos en la próxima escena.
See you next time!
